name: modify-pod-status-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Lateral Movement::ARP poisoning and IP spoofing

description: determines which subjects can modify the pods/status subresource, letting them relabel a pod until it matches a service's selector so the service routes traffic to it, intercepting connections to services in the pod's namespace
remediation: Remove update and patch on pods/status from the role, and grant them only to the components that reconcile pod state, such as the kubelet and the workload controllers. Avoid wildcard resources and */status entries in roles bound to workloads or users.
